source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public Deuteronomy 29:1 binds Hebrew 28:69; public 29:2–29 binds Hebrew 29:1–28. All other public verses in chapters 27–34 align directly. All 266 original XML records, including written/read and numbering notes, are hashed in full.

key_decisions.decision: Binds public 29:1 to Hebrew 28:69 and preserves the covenant’s relationship to Horeb.
Keeps divine non-giving as stated rather than substituting a claim that the people simply refused.
Preserves the first-person divine voice within Moses’ speech, forty years, and repeated non-wearing.
Retains the explicit divine self-identification and the three absent foods or drinks.
Makes the sanction-bearing force of the oath explicit while continuing its purpose into verse 13.
Preserves self-blessing and the difficult watered/thirsty saying instead of assigning a certain moral identity to its two parts.
Preserves the hidden/revealed distinction and practical purpose; the full source hash retains the special textual dots.
